preconditions.description: Grid dimensions n and m are within bounds, and total cells n*m is within the limit.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= f[i][j] <= n * m for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: Each cell's silence level f[i][j] is within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: len({f[i][j] for i in range(n) for j in range(m)}) == n * m
preconditions.description: All silence levels f[i][j] are distinct (permutation of 1 to n*m).

postconditions.description: Output is a non-negative integer representing the count of pleasant segments.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= n * m for l in range(1, n * m + 1) for r in range(l, n * m + 1) if (l, r) in pleasant_segments)
postconditions.description: Every pleasant segment [l, r] has valid bounds 1 ≤ l ≤ r ≤ n*m.

postconditions.expression: all(is_pleasant_segment(l, r, f, n, m) for l in range(1, n * m + 1) for r in range(l, n * m + 1) if (l, r) in pleasant_segments)
postconditions.description: Every segment [l, r] in the output is indeed pleasant, meaning the set S of cells with l ≤ f[i][j] ≤ r forms a tree (connected and acyclic) in the grid.
The output integer exactly matches the count of distinct pleasant segments.
